Anant Singh Daughter Wedding News : anant sinh apne damad ko kya-kya de rahe hain? | Shivangi Singh | Mokama | Bihar News
Anant sinh apni beti ki shadi ki taiyari men jute hain aur damad ko gipht men kya-kya de rahe hain, yah charcha joron par hai. khabar hai ki mokama vidhayak anant sinh apne hone vale damad ko diphendar gipht karne ja rahe hain. mol rod par sthit nilam devi ke aavas par chamachmati diphendar pahunch bhi chuki hai.
